metadata.question: Was the increase in nighttime light intensity in Antakya, the capital of Türkiye’s Hatay Province, greater on February 21, 2023 than April 30, 2023?

data.exec_msg:
Avg Nighttime Radiance (Feb 2023): 10.21 (Pixels: 216)
Avg Nighttime Radiance (Apr 2023): 17.48 (Pixels: 216)
The question asks if the light intensity was greater on Feb 21 than Apr 30.
B
